protocolRefs.multiCallChain: DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

constraints: xPath uses a subset of XPath notation (absolute/relative paths, indexed predicates like para[1]/para[last()]); if any intermediate path elements don't exist, they are created, otherwise a new node is added.
If the tree (elementRef) has one or more namespaces defined, xPath must be prefixed with the namespace to use (e.g. "MyNameSpace:MyElement").
Non-text attrValue values (Boolean, Integer, Real, Date, Time) are automatically converted to their text representation.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates a new XML element at a given XPath location under elementRef, optionally setting attribute name/value pairs on it, and returns its reference.
